terminus.status: SYNTHESIS REVISION · CAPABILITY CAN BE AN EFFECT
terminus.finding: Wei Long-da and Hsieh Sheng-you's study argues that Taiwan community-building policy, despite possible elite nation-building intentions, could positively alter people's imagination of the public and promote participation.
terminus.generated: Activation capacity should not be treated only as a pre-existing input. Participation can recursively manufacture future activation capacity by changing public imagination, habits and willingness to coordinate. Revised temporal model: topology -> opportunity for interaction; activation capacity -> effective use; repeated participation -> capacity reproduction or decay.
terminus.relationToPrevious: Turns the previous static topology/activation distinction into a feedback model. It also adds a falsification requirement: repeated participation may generate fatigue, capture or dependency instead of capacity.
terminus.next: seek a case where repeated participation exists but activation capacity decays or becomes concentrated
